title: ShotTimelineAsset manifest (asset.json)
description: Self-describing manifest for a ShotTimelineAsset — a portable, multi-track shot decomposition produced by kais-shot-timeline and consumed by downstream canvases (e.g. @kais/infinite-canvas). The manifest carries the schema_version, source provenance, generator identity, the inventory of 5 canonical data JSON files, and the inventory of canonical media files (video + 3 stems). Producer (Phase 2): exporter writing asset.json into the asset directory. Consumer: any reader that wants to understand the asset without external docs.
$comment: Graceful-degrade rule (SPEC-02 / CONTEXT D-02): The schema is intentionally strict (additionalProperties: false on every object). Strictness at validation time is what forces explicit version bumps. The CONSUMER, however, must be lenient at RUNTIME: on an unknown or newer schema_version, ignore unknown fields, render the known parts, and emit a warning — do NOT reject or crash. New field = minor version bump (old consumers degrade gracefully). Breaking change (rename, semantic shift, removal) = major bump, and MUST be documented in the prose SPEC migration section. Semver-lite: major[.minor], e.g. "1" or "1.1" — NOT full semver (no patch component, no pre-release tags).

schema_version.description: Asset contract version, semver-lite (major[.minor]). Examples: "1", "1.1", "2.0". Non-examples: "v1", "1.1.1", "". Consumer MUST graceful-degrade on unknown/newer versions: ignore unknown fields, render known parts, emit a warning — do NOT reject. New field = minor bump; breaking change (rename/semantic shift/removal) = major bump (document migration in SPEC.md).

asset_type.description: Asset kind discriminator. Always the literal "shottimeline" for this contract — lets a future reader distinguish this asset kind from others sharing a directory.

source.description: Provenance of the original source video.

video_filename.description: Original source video filename (basename, e.g. "《小江湖》第03话：….mp4").

duration_sec.description: Source video duration in seconds (from ffprobe).

generator.description: Identity of the tool that produced this asset.

version.description: Tool version (any string — semver, git SHA, build id).

warnings.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — Phase 6). Non-fatal warnings encountered during asset generation (e.g. cinematography route unreachable → empty prompts facets). Older assets omit it and still validate (graceful-degrade). Producer emits the field only when the list is non-empty; absent on clean runs. Operator-facing failure reasons only (exception class + message, route status codes) — no PII, no auth tokens, no body payloads. v1.3 widening：items 从纯 string 加宽为双形（v1.x 首个 items 类型加宽；对旧数据 additive —— 纯 string 条目仍合法）。v1.3 起 [roundtrip] degrade 记因条目为结构化 {code, detail}（RT-04）：code 是 closed enum（comfyui_unreachable / vram_insufficient / scorer_model_missing）使三因由机器可 grep；detail 是 producer-local 自由文本（no PII, no auth tokens 惯例延续）。degrade 记因最小单元是 code —— detail 可缺席。

registry_snapshot.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — Phase 8). generator.registry_snapshot is a frozen-at-export-time compact view of confirmed registry entries (characters + props). Embeds id/name/representative_image/appearance_shots per entry — enough for a consumer to resolve prompts.character_refs[]/prop_refs[] and render a gallery WITHOUT re-reading external characters.json/props.json. The registry_snapshot is the export-time truth: later registry mutations (re-review, re-cluster, rename) cannot invalidate already-exported prompt references (Pitfall 18 prevented). Older assets omit registry_snapshot and still validate (graceful-degrade). Producer emits registry_snapshot only when characters.json or props.json exists at export time; absent on assets produced without re-id (v1.0 byte-identical).

characters.description: Character entries in registry_snapshot — confirmed-only (review_state=='confirmed') projection of characters.json at export time. Compact 4-field shape (id/name/representative_image/appearance_shots); omits looks[].

props.description: Prop entries in registry_snapshot — confirmed-only projection of props.json at export time. Same compact 4-field shape as characters; omits states[].

data.description: Inventory of the 5 canonical data JSON files. Each value is a path relative to the asset root.

shots.description: Relative path to shots.json (no parent traversal, no drive letters, must end in .json).

characters.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — absent on v1 assets). Relative path to characters.json (the canonical confirmed character registry produced by Phase 7 HITL apply_edits). Emitted only when re-id ran and review confirmed entries; older assets omit it and still validate (graceful-degrade).

props.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — absent on v1 assets). Relative path to props.json (canonical confirmed prop registry). Same emission rule as characters.

audio_semantic.description: v1.2 additive (OPTIONAL — 缺席 on v1.0/v1.1 assets). Relative path to audio_semantic.json (per-shot 三模态 dialogue/sfx + reproduction prompts produced by Phase 15). Emitted only when route-host round-trip succeeded AND the file exists on disk; older assets omit it and still validate (graceful-degrade, CONTRACT-05).

speakers.description: v1.2 additive (OPTIONAL — 缺席 on v1.0/v1.1 assets). Relative path to speakers.json (canonical confirmed speaker registry produced by Phase 13 HITL link_speakers). Same emission rule as characters/props — file exists on disk → emit; absent → OMIT (byte-identical to v1.0/v1.1 producer output).

roundtrip.description: v1.3 additive (OPTIONAL — 缺席 on v1.0/v1.1/v1.2 assets). Round-trip validation sidecar mount（RT-01）. 与兄弟挂载不同，这不是纯 string path —— 值是 v1.x 第一个 object 值 data.* 挂载：携带 file ref（path，pattern 与兄弟挂载同款）+ accepted_count/rejected_count 统计字段，让 consumer 不打开 roundtrip.json 即可渲染 verdict 概览；per-shot 数据留在 sidecar 内（不内嵌 per-shot 数据）。Emission rule：roundtrip.json 存在且可 JSON 解析才 emit；malformed/non-dict → OMIT（[warn] + 不持久化可疑统计，mirror registry_snapshot WR-05）。不进 data.required[]（additive-only，5 keys 不变）。

path.description: Relative path to roundtrip.json (canonical: roundtrip.json at asset root). Anti-traversal enforced, identical pattern to sibling data.* mounts.

accepted_count.description: roundtrip.json 内 verdict.decision=='accepted' 的 shot 计数（producer export 时统计）。

rejected_count.description: roundtrip.json 内 verdict.decision=='rejected' 的 shot 计数。verdict 缺席或其它值的 shot 不计入。

media.description: Inventory of canonical media files. Paths are relative to the asset root and MUST follow the canonical naming (CONTEXT D-03): video.mp4 at root or one directory deep; stems under stems/{vocals,drums,other}.wav. The producer's pre-canonical layout (stems/htdemucs/<stem>/{vocals,drums,bass,other}.wav) is NOT accepted here — the Phase 2 exporter renames to canonical before writing asset.json. bass.wav is intentionally excluded (consumer frontend only uses 3 stems).

video.description: Relative path to the canonical video file. Must end in video.mp4 (optionally under one or more directory segments). Rejects ../video.mp4, /abs/video.mp4, video.avi.

stems.description: Canonical 3-stem WAV inventory (bass is excluded — consumer only renders vocals/drums/other).

vocals.description: Relative path to vocals WAV. Canonical: stems/vocals.wav.

drums.description: Relative path to drums WAV. Canonical: stems/drums.wav.

other.description: Relative path to other WAV. Canonical: stems/other.wav.

characters.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — absent on v1 assets). External character portrait PNGs as relative paths (NOT base64 — prevents 10-50x asset bloat). Anti-traversal enforced (rejects ../, absolute paths, Windows reserved chars). Canonical naming: characters/<id>.png. Served via Range-aware HTTP (serve.py), same as video/stems.

props.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — absent on v1 assets). External prop PNGs as relative paths (NOT base64). Anti-traversal enforced. Canonical: props/<id>.png.
